slot.campHint: Camp clothes are packed for downtime, not worn. An item here is unequipped, so its armour and magic don't apply.
slot.empty: {label}: empty. Click to choose an item, or drop one here.
slot.conflict: {item} is in the off hand while {weapon} needs both hands

reject.twoHandedOffHand: {item} needs both hands. Put it in the {main} slot.
reject.offHandBlocked: {weapon} in {main} needs both hands. Unequip it first.
reject.notOwner: You don't have permission to change {actor}'s equipment.
reject.foreign: Only items {actor} already carries can be equipped here.
reject.setUnknown: That saved set no longer exists.
reject.setsFull: A character can keep {max} saved sets. Delete one first.
reject.setNoName: Give the set a name first.

sets.title: Saved Sets
sets.none: No saved sets yet. Dress {actor} the way you want, then name the set below and save it.
sets.deleteContent: Delete the saved set {set}? Its items stay in the inventory.
sets.namePlaceholder: Name this set, such as Battle
sets.saveHint: Saves everything worn now. Saving under an existing name replaces that set.
sets.missing: {set}: {items} no longer carried, so left out.

stats.attunementOver: Attuned to more items than allowed

unslotted.title: Also Worn
unslotted.hint: Equipped, but no free slot fits. Free one up, or drag it onto a slot.

portrait.title: Loadout Portrait: {actor}
portrait.srcHint: Leave blank to use the character's own portrait. A full-body picture looks best.
portrait.focusHint: Which part of a tall picture to keep in view when it fills the frame.

slotConfig.title: Loadout Slots
slotConfig.intro: Choose which slots every character's loadout shows. Items already worn in a slot you turn off stay equipped and appear under Also Worn.
slotConfig.rangedHint: A second weapon set to the right of the hands. With two slots, the first is the ranged main hand and the second its off hand: a two-handed bow in the first blocks the second, just as a greatsword blocks the off hand.
slotConfig.trinketsHint: Up to five catch-all slots for worn magic items with no better home: ioun stones, figurines, gems. They share a bar with the light source, instrument and tools slots.
slotConfig.campHint: Adds a Camp group for downtime clothing: an outfit, underwear and footwear, like Baldur's Gate 3's camp slots. Camp clothes are packed, not worn: putting an item there unequips it, so its armour and magic don't apply.

sheetTab.name: Loadout Tab
sheetTab.hint: Add a Loadout tab to the D&D 5e character sheet, and to Tidy 5e Sheet's when Tidy is active. Reloads the world when changed.

dockButton.name: Docked Loadout Button
dockButton.hint: Add a Loadout button to character sheet headers that opens the loadout in its own window, docked beside the sheet.

dockSide.name: Dock Side
dockSide.hint: Which side of the sheet the docked loadout prefers. If there isn't room, it uses the other side.

autoDock.name: Open Docked Loadout With Sheets
autoDock.hint: Open the docked loadout automatically whenever you open a character sheet.

strictSlots.name: Strict Slot Matching
strictSlots.hint: When on, worn accessories only fit the slot they belong in: boots on feet, cloaks on the back. When off, any accessory fits any accessory slot. Armor, shields, weapons and rings follow the rules either way.

foreignDrops.name: Dropping New Items
foreignDrops.hint: Who may drop an item the character doesn't already carry (from a compendium or the Items sidebar) onto the loadout. The item is added to the character's inventory and equipped.

slotLayoutMenu.name: Loadout Slots
slotLayoutMenu.label: Configure Slots
slotLayoutMenu.hint: How many ring, ranged weapon and trinket slots every character has, which optional slots are shown, and whether camp clothes slots are on.

debugLogging.name: Debug Logging
debugLogging.hint: Print Loadout diagnostics to your browser console. Only affects you.

toggleDock.name: Toggle Docked Loadout
toggleDock.hint: Open or close the docked loadout for your selected token's character, or your assigned character.
